q: Choose the correct passive form of the sentence: 'Who made the mistake?"
o: By whom was the mistake made?
The mistake was made by whom?
Who was made the mistake?
By whom the mistake was made?
e: Who দিয়ে শুরু হওয়া প্রশ্নের passive করতে who বদলে by whom বসে, আর প্রশ্নবোধক কাঠামো রাখতে auxiliary verb subject-এর আগে আসে। মূল বাক্য past tense এবং object 'the mistake' একবচন, তাই passive: By whom was the mistake made? গঠন হলো By whom + was/were + subject + past participle। 'The mistake was made by whom?' কথ্য বিস্ময়সূচক প্রশ্নে চলতে পারে, কিন্তু প্রমিত passive প্রশ্ন নয়। 'Who was made the mistake?' অর্থহীন, আর 'By whom the mistake was made?'-এ auxiliary আগে না বসায় প্রশ্নের কাঠামো নেই। একই নিয়মে: Who wrote this letter? → By whom was this letter written?

q: Find the passive voice: Somebody should have called the president this morning.
o: The president should have been called this morning
The president could have been called this morning
The president might have been called this morning
The president could be called this morning
e: Somebody কর্তা হলে passive-এ তা বাদ যায়। modal + have + V3 গঠনের passive হলো modal + have been + V3, তাই The president should have been called this morning। অর্থ: আজ সকালে রাষ্ট্রপতিকে ডাকা উচিত ছিল। অন্য অপশনগুলোতে modal বদলে (could, might) মূল অর্থ বদলে গেছে।
